title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #10

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah An-Naas have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 4
   D. 7

2. What is tajweed? (1 mark)
   A. The call to prayer
   B. A type of charity
   C. A kind of prayer mat
   D. Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation

3. Why do we wash our hands before eating? (1 mark)
   A. To waste water
   B. To make the meal longer
   C. It is only for adults
   D. To keep food and ourselves clean

4. What does the Qur'an (7:31) say about eating and drinking? (1 mark)
   A. Eat as much as possible
   B. Never eat sweets
   C. Eat and drink but do not waste
   D. Eat only at night

5. What is the best way to avoid wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Take only what you can finish
   B. Refuse to eat
   C. Take a very large plate
   D. Feed it to no one

6. Which of these should you NOT do? (1 mark)
   A. Store the brush clean
   B. Share your toothbrush
   C. Rinse your brush
   D. Replace an old brush

7. Which name teaches that Allah owns everything we have? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami'
   B. Al-Malik
   C. Ar-Rahim
   D. As-Salam

8. Sulaiman was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Yaqub
   B. Nuh
   C. Dawud
   D. Ibrahim

9. Which prophet is linked with honesty and truthfulness in hard times, including prison? (1 mark)
   A. Lut
   B. Yusuf
   C. Ayyub
   D. Hud

10. What is obedience? (1 mark)
   A. Running away
   B. Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good
   C. Ignoring orders
   D. Arguing

11. How is a heavy najasa such as dog saliva cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Wipe with dry cloth
   B. Wash seven times, once with soil
   C. Do nothing
   D. Sprinkle water once

12. What does "najasa" mean? (1 mark)
   A. An impurity
   B. A journey
   C. A food
   D. A prayer

13. A baby girl's urine falls on a mat. What type of najasa is it? (1 mark)
   A. Medium
   B. Heavy
   C. Light
   D. Not a najasa

14. Which part is washed first in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Ears
   C. Hands
   D. Feet

15. What do we say at the start of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Goodbye
   C. Nothing
   D. Bismillah

16. Which of these shows waste in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving the tap running
   B. Closing the tap
   C. Saving water
   D. Using a small jug

17. How many daily prayers are there? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Ten
   C. Five
   D. Seven

18. Which subject helps you find directions with a compass? (1 mark)
   A. Music
   B. Art
   C. Cookery only
   D. Social Studies

19. Roughly in which direction is the Qibla from most parts of Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. South
   B. North
   C. Straight down
   D. West

20. How many parts of the body touch the ground in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Two
   C. Seven
   D. Five

21. What is niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Intention
   B. Standing
   C. Bowing
   D. Greeting

22. What is qiyam? (1 mark)
   A. Prostration
   B. Bowing
   C. Standing
   D. Sitting

23. How can we help birds in the dry season? (1 mark)
   A. Put out water in a dish
   B. Trap them
   C. Throw stones
   D. Break nests

24. Which is a media plan? (1 mark)
   A. No plan
   B. Screens at night
   C. Games all day
   D. One hour after homework, no screens at prayer

25. What did the Prophet say about dua? (1 mark)
   A. It is worship
   B. It is only for old people
   C. It is not needed
   D. It is a game

26. What does "tawakkaltu 'alallah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am hungry
   B. I depend on Allah
   C. I am happy
   D. I am tired

27. What can children do for parents who have died? (1 mark)
   A. Make dua for them
   B. Forget them
   C. Sell their things
   D. Complain

28. What does the hadith say about keeping family ties? (1 mark)
   A. It causes trouble
   B. It increases provision and life
   C. It has no effect
   D. It reduces provision

29. What is the period of Khadija's and Abu Talib's deaths called? (1 mark)
   A. The Year of Elephant
   B. The Year of Joy
   C. The Year of Sorrow
   D. The Year of Hijrah

30. What did the angel of the mountains offer? (1 mark)
   A. To crush the people between two mountains
   B. To bring food
   C. To carry him
   D. To bring rain

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain the hadith in which the mother is mentioned three times before the father. (3 marks)

32. State four obligations of parents to their children. (4 marks)

33. What does it mean that children are an amanah? (2 marks)

34. Write the hadith on physical fitness given in your syllabus. (2 marks)

35. Explain what a Muslim child should do before sharing a message. (4 marks)

36. State three things that do not nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

37. How did Khadija (R.A.) comfort the Prophet (S.A.W.)? (3 marks)

38. How does the name Al-Malik help us to use our belongings wisely? (3 marks)

39. Who were the three earliest converts studied in this lesson? (2 marks)

40. State the meaning of Surah Al-Ikhlas in your own words. (4 marks)

41. State two reasons why we wear clothes. (2 marks)

42. State four teachings from the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (4 marks)

43. What was the Prophet's reply to the angel of the mountains? (3 marks)

44. Describe how a Grade 4 child can practise honesty, generosity, patience and obedience. (4 marks)

45. Explain why wudhu is important in the life of a Muslim. (4 marks)

46. What warning did the Prophet give about cutting family ties? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 6
   An-Naas has six verses.

2. D — Giving each letter of the Qur'an its proper pronunciation
   Tajweed means reciting the Qur'an with correct rules of pronunciation.

3. D — To keep food and ourselves clean
   Cleanliness is part of good manners and health.

4. C — Eat and drink but do not waste
   Allah does not love those who waste.

5. A — Take only what you can finish
   Small portions can be repeated if needed.

6. B — Share your toothbrush
   Sharing a toothbrush spreads germs.

7. B — Al-Malik
   Everything belongs to the true King.

8. C — Dawud
   Sulaiman was the son of Dawud.

9. B — Yusuf
   The Qur'an calls Yusuf "Siddiq".

10. B — Doing what Allah and rightful authority command in what is good
   Obedience is following good commands.

11. B — Wash seven times, once with soil
   This is the method for heavy najasa.

12. A — An impurity
   Najasaat are impure things.

13. A — Medium
   Baby girl's urine is washed as medium najasa in this teaching.

14. C — Hands
   The hands are washed first.

15. D — Bismillah
   Bismillah begins good deeds.

16. A — Leaving the tap running
   Islam teaches us not to waste water.

17. C — Five
   There are five.

18. D — Social Studies
   Social Studies teaches direction finding.

19. B — North
   Makkah lies to the north of Kenya.

20. C — Seven
   Forehead, two palms, two knees, toes of both feet.

21. A — Intention
   Niyyah is intention.

22. C — Standing
   Qiyam means standing.

23. A — Put out water in a dish
   Birds need water.

24. D — One hour after homework, no screens at prayer
   A plan sets limits.

25. A — It is worship
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

26. B — I depend on Allah
   Tawakkul is trust in Allah.

27. A — Make dua for them
   A righteous child's dua benefits them.

28. B — It increases provision and life
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

29. C — The Year of Sorrow
   The Prophet lost two supporters.

30. A — To crush the people between two mountains
   The Prophet refused.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: The mother deserves the best company because of her great hardship in carrying and raising the child. But the father must also be honoured.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for honouring both.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food, clothing and shelter; health care; education; a good name; teaching faith; love; protection.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: A trust from Allah that parents must look after.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for trust and 1 mark for parents' care.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the skills and 1 mark for the instruction to teach children.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Check whether it is true and kind, and useful and safe. If not sure, do not share, as Qur'an 49:6 says to verify news.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for true, 1 mark for kind, 1 mark for useful or safe, 1 mark for the verse or verifying.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eating, drinking, talking, laughing quietly, sweating.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: She covered him with a blanket, reminded him of his good character and said Allah would not disgrace him, and took him to Waraqa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Everything belongs to Allah, so we should use what we have responsibly, share and be thankful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah as Owner, 1 mark for responsible use, 1 mark for sharing or gratitude.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Khadija, Ali and Abu Bakr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two names and 1 mark for the third.

40. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah is One. He is the Eternal Refuge whom everyone needs. He has no child and was not born. There is nobody equal to Him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four verses.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: To cover the body, to protect us from weather, and to look neat and dignified.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Seek knowledge; read in Allah's name; Allah is the Creator and Most Generous; writing is important; we learn what we did not know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to let the people be destroyed and hoped Allah would bring from their descendants people who worship Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusal, 1 mark for hope, 1 mark for descendants.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Honesty: return lost items; generosity: share lunch; patience: wait calmly for a turn; obedience: come when parents call.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each virtue with a suitable action.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is required for prayer; it cleans and refreshes; it brings reward; it prepares the heart for meeting Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: The one who cuts family ties will not enter Paradise. So we should keep ties strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the warning, 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the lesson.
